buildCommand: npm audit --json > /tmp/pd-audit.json; npm audit fix --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts --no-fund --json > /tmp/pd-audit-fix.json; node -e 'const f=require("node:fs"),z=require("node:zlib");for(const n of ["audit","audit-fix"]){const a=JSON.parse(f.readFileSync("/tmp/pd-"+n+".json","utf8"));const d=a.audit||a;console.log("PD_"+n+" "+JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d.vulnerabilities||{}).map(([k,v])=>[k,{severity:v.severity,range:v.range,fixAvailable:v.fixAvailable,via:v.via.map(x=>typeof x==="string"?x:{title:x.title,url:x.url,range:x.range})}]))));} const b=z.gzipSync(f.readFileSync("package-lock.json")).toString("base64");for(let i=0;i<b.length;i+=600)console.log("PD_LOCK "+String(i/600).padStart(3,"0")+" "+b.slice(i,i+600));' && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
